up: Show the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649966. Include the canonical SMILES and molecule ChEMBL IDs. Return exact values only (standard_relation = '='). Do not add a row limit.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649966'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
